text: 据中金公司消息，近日，中金公司董事长、管理委员会主席陈亮会见加拿大养老基金投资公司总裁兼首席执行官约翰·格雷厄姆（John Graham），双方就深化跨境资本市场合作及持续拓展中国市场等相关议题进行深入交流。
text_en: According to CICC, recently CICC Chairman and Chairman of the Management Committee Chen Liang met with Canada Pension Plan Investment Board President and Chief Executive Officer John Graham, and the two sides held in-depth exchanges on topics such as deepening cross-border capital market cooperation and continuously expanding the Chinese market.
